manifest.name: dsh-graphics
manifest.description: Excalidraw canvases inside the workspace for DeepSeek Harness: five agent tools to draw, read and update .excalidraw files, SVG export, and rendered PNGs handed straight back to the model so it can see its own drawing.
manifest.author: Juer.G Whang <juergenie@outlook.com>

scripts.check: for f in lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.test: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/render-tool.mjs && node tests/integration.mjs && node tests/render.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh-graphics — 把工作区里的 Excalidraw 画布接进 DeepSeek Harness。
#
# 本文件是 profile 的补丁层：`dsh` 读取 package.json 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 后按顺序应用它。
# 安装由 DSH 的 plugin_manager（action: install_bundle）完成——不要手写 profile 的
# package.json / cordis.patch.yml，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。
#
# 注意：补丁会**整体替换**匹配行的 config，所以这里只声明本插件自己的行，不要顺带改别人的行。
#
# 配置项（实现后生效）：
#   directory: graphics    # 新画布默认落在工作区下的哪个子目录
#   maxCanvasBytes: 8388608
#   maxElements: 20000
- insert:
    - id: graphics
      name: dsh-graphics
      config:
        directory: graphics

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：**工作区内的 Excalidraw 画布**，让 Agent 能画图、读图，并把渲染出来的图**直接交给模型看**。

> 状态：**v0.1.0 功能完成**。5 个 Agent 工具已在 live 会话注册并对模型可见，
> 渲染图能作为图像内容块回传给模型（M1 / M3 已过真机验收）；Excalidraw 编辑面板已落地并按真机反馈迭代。
> 全量 64 项测试通过（smoke 25 / render 10 / render-tool 13 / integration 16）。
> 见 [`docs/plan.md`](docs/plan.md)。

---

DSH 里让模型产出"图"的常见做法是生成 SVG / Mermaid 文本，模型自己看不到结果，用户也得另找工具打开。
dsh-graphics 换一条路：

- **画布是工作区里的普通文件**（`.excalidraw` JSON），模型能用现有文件工具读、能进 Git、能随项目走；
- **Agent 有专门的画图/读图工具**，不必手写底层元素 JSON；
- **渲染图直接作为图像内容块回传给模型**，模型在下一轮就能"看见"自己画的东西并自我修正；
- **导出 SVG** 落地到工作区，供用户使用或作为交付物（PNG 只走附件服务，见「已知限制」）。

---

| 工具              | 作用                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `graphics_list`   | 列出工作区内的画布                                           |
| `graphics_read`   | 读画布：结构化摘要（页面/元素/文字/关系），而非整份元素 JSON |
| `graphics_create` | 从语义化描述创建画布                                         |
| `graphics_update` | 对已有画布做批量增删改                                       |
| `graphics_render` | 渲染并**把图回传给模型**；可选把 SVG 导出到工作区            |

在 DSH Web 里提供一个 Excalidraw 编辑面板：打开工作区中的 `.excalidraw` 文件、直接编辑、手动保存回原文件（带版本冲突保护）。

---

```
dsh-graphics/
├── package.json          # DSH 插件清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 把插件插进 profile 的补丁层
├── lib/

DSH 的官方包（`@deepseek-ai/*`）打包在 `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar`
里——那是个归档文件，不是目录，`ls` / `cat` / ripgrep 都打不开。这个小脚本能按路径正则把里面的
实现代码与 `README.zh.md` 提取出来，是解决 `docs/design.md` §9 那些待定问题的工具：

```sh
bun tools/asar-extract.mjs \
  "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" \
  "$TMPDIR/dsh-api" \
  'dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs/(README\.zh\.md|package\.json|.*\.d\.ts)$'

> 注意：asar 里**不含 `.d.ts`**。精确的类型定义要去 npm 取同版本的发布包
> （`registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/<pkg>/-/<pkg>-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz`）。

---
```sh

readme.section: 由 DSH 的 plugin_manager 完成，不要手写 profile 的 package.json
readme.text:
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=/Users/juergenie/Projects/Workspaces/dsh-graphics
```

> 清单里已声明 `dsh.client`（`lib/client.js` 与 `editor/dist/` 构建产物都已就位），加载后会注册
> 右侧栏画布标签页。反过来，**在构建产物存在之前不要声明 `dsh.client`**——Web 启动审计会明确报
> 「激活失败」。这是从 `dsh-plugin-chat-mode` 的 `AGENTS.md` 里学到的教训（"别声明不存在的能力"）。

---

- [设计文档](docs/design.md)
- [开发计划](docs/plan.md)
- [调研结论](docs/research.md)
- [宿主侧集成笔记](docs/host-integration-notes.md)
- [工作指引](AGENTS.md)

---

```
graphics_list                        列出工作区里的画布
graphics_create path=… elements=[…]  画一张画布（语义化元素，不用写底层 JSON）
graphics_read   path=…               读回结构摘要（含容器的绑定标签）
graphics_update path=… ops=[…]       批量增删改，一次落盘

`graphics_render` 是核心：它把 PNG 经 `attachments.saveImage()` 登记后，
以 `{type:'image', attachment}` 内容块回传，模型在下一轮就能看见自己画的东西。
带 `outputPath` 时还会把 SVG 导出到工作区（PNG 不行——`ctx.fs` 的变更操作是 UTF-8 文本专用）。

在 DSH Web 的文件树里点开任意 `.excalidraw` 文件，右侧栏会出现 Excalidraw 编辑器。

编辑器**不做自动保存**——画原型时频繁写盘既吵又危险（手一滑就覆盖了上一版）。
改动只在本地累积，标签页顶部工具栏显示「有未保存的改动」；点**保存**才落盘，
并有版本冲突保护（文件被 Agent 改过时会拒绝覆盖而不是静默丢失）。

工具栏另一个按钮是**引用到输入框**：点一下把当前画布的路径插进会话输入框，
于是 Agent 下一轮就能用 `graphics_read` / `graphics_render` 看到它——人和模型共用同一张画布。

输入框的 **`+` 按钮**（与键入 `/` 打开同一个菜单）里还有一条**画布**命令：
点一下就新建一张 `graphics/canvas-<时间戳>.excalidraw` 并在编辑器里打开，用来随手画点东西。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build:editor     # vite build + 拷贝 Excalidraw 字体到 editor/dist
pnpm test             # 64 项测试（画布模型 / 渲染 / 图像回传 / 模拟宿主集成）
```

`editor/dist/` 是构建产物（约 21MB，其中 13MB 是字体），**不进版本库**；
分发时由 `package.json` 的 `files` 带上。

- **PNG 不能导出到工作区**：`ctx.fs` 的变更操作只支持 UTF-8 文本
  （`dsh-fs` README：「二进制安全的变更操作仍延期」）。PNG 走附件服务，
  以图像交给模型，并返回附件库的真实宿主路径；落盘用 SVG。
- **宿主侧代码改动必须重启 DSH**：profile 下 HMR 不监听源码模块。见
  [docs/host-integration-notes.md](docs/host-integration-notes.md) §2。
- 编辑器 iframe 不继承宿主主题 token，初始主题取系统偏好（Excalidraw 自带主题开关）。

[中文](README.md) | English

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: **Excalidraw canvases inside the workspace**, so an agent can draw, read back what it drew, and have the rendered picture **handed straight to the model**.

> Status: **v0.1.0, feature-complete**. All five agent tools are registered in a live session and visible to the model, and rendered images come back as image content blocks (M1 / M3 passed acceptance on a live DSH install). The Excalidraw editor panel is in place and has been iterated on real-world feedback. All 64 tests pass (smoke 25 / render 10 / render-tool 13 / integration 16). See [`docs/plan.md`](docs/plan.md).

---

The usual way to get a picture out of a model in DSH is to generate SVG or Mermaid text — the model never sees the result, and you have to go find another tool to open it. dsh-graphics takes a different route:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `graphics_list` | List the canvases in the workspace |
| `graphics_read` | Read a canvas back as a structural summary (pages / elements / text / relationships) instead of the whole element array |
| `graphics_create` | Create a canvas from a semantic description |
| `graphics_update` | Batch add / update / remove on an existing canvas |
| `graphics_render` | Render and **hand the image back to the model**; optionally export the SVG to the workspace |

A right-sidebar Excalidraw editor panel in DSH Web: open a `.excalidraw` file from the workspace, edit it, and save it back to the same file by hand (with version-conflict protection).

---

```
dsh-graphics/
├── package.json          # DSH plugin manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # the patch layer that inserts the plugin into a profile
├── lib/

DSH's official packages (`@deepseek-ai/*`) ship inside
`/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar` — that is an archive, not a
directory, so `ls` / `cat` / ripgrep cannot open it. This small script extracts implementation
code and `README.zh.md` from it by path regex, and it is what answered the open questions in
`docs/design.md` §9:

```sh
bun tools/asar-extract.mjs \
  "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" \
  "$TMPDIR/dsh-api" \
  'dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs/(README\.zh\.md|package\.json|.*\.d\.ts)$'

> Note: the asar contains **no `.d.ts` files**. For exact type definitions, fetch the published
> package of the same version from npm
> (`registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/<pkg>/-/<pkg>-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz`).

---
```sh

readme.section: Handled by DSH's plugin_manager — do not hand-edit a profile's package.json
readme.text:
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=/Users/juergenie/Projects/Workspaces/dsh-graphics
```

readme.section: Handled by DSH's plugin_manager — do not hand-edit a profile's package.json
readme.text:
> The manifest declares `dsh.client` (`lib/client.js` and the built `editor/dist/` are both in
> place), so loading it registers the right-sidebar canvas tab. Conversely, **do not declare
> `dsh.client` before its build output exists** — the Web startup audit reports an activation
> failure for that. This is the lesson learned from `dsh-plugin-chat-mode`'s `AGENTS.md`
> ("don't declare a capability that isn't there").

---

- [Design](docs/design.md)
- [Development plan](docs/plan.md)
- [Research notes](docs/research.md)
- [Host integration notes](docs/host-integration-notes.md)
- [Working guide](AGENTS.md)

---

```
graphics_list                        list the canvases in the workspace
graphics_create path=… elements=[…]  draw a canvas (semantic elements, no low-level JSON)
graphics_read   path=…               read back a structural summary (including container labels)
graphics_update path=… ops=[…]       batch add/update/remove, written in one pass

`graphics_render` is the core. It registers the PNG through `attachments.saveImage()` and
returns it as a `{type:'image', attachment}` content block, so the model sees what it drew on its
next step. With `outputPath` it also exports the SVG into the workspace (PNG cannot go there —
`ctx.fs` mutation is UTF-8 text only).

Open any `.excalidraw` file from the file tree in DSH Web and the Excalidraw editor appears in
the right sidebar.

The editor **does not autosave** — writing to disk constantly while sketching is both noisy and
dangerous (one slip overwrites the previous revision). Changes accumulate locally and the
toolbar at the top of the tab shows "unsaved changes"; only **Save** writes to disk, and it has
version-conflict protection (if the agent changed the file, it refuses to overwrite rather than
silently losing that work).

The other toolbar button is **Insert into composer**: it drops the current canvas path into the
session input box, so on the next turn the agent can reach it with `graphics_read` /
`graphics_render` — you and the model share one canvas.

The composer's **`+` button** (the same menu as typing `/`) also has a **Canvas** command: it
creates a fresh `graphics/canvas-<timestamp>.excalidraw` and opens it in the editor for quick
sketching.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build:editor     # vite build + copy Excalidraw fonts into editor/dist
pnpm test             # 64 tests (canvas model / rendering / image hand-off / mocked host integration)
```

`editor/dist/` is build output (about 21 MB, 13 MB of it fonts) and **is not committed**; the
`files` field in `package.json` ships it.

- **PNG cannot be exported into the workspace**: `ctx.fs` mutation is UTF-8 text only (the
  `dsh-fs` README: "binary-safe mutation is still deferred"). PNG goes through the attachment
  service, is handed to the model as an image, and the attachment store's real host path is
  returned; use SVG for anything that has to land on disk.
- **Host-side code changes require restarting DSH**: HMR under a profile does not watch source
  modules. See [docs/host-integration-notes.md](docs/host-integration-notes.md) §2.
- The editor iframe does not inherit the host's theme tokens; the initial theme follows the
  system preference (Excalidraw ships its own theme toggle).
